event.title: Super Mario Bros. Released
event.description: Nintendo releases Super Mario Bros. in Japan for the Famicom. Mario sets out to rescue Princess Toadstool from Bowser.

event.title: Super Mario 64 Released
event.description: Super Mario 64 launches in Japan for the Nintendo 64, bringing Mario into a fully 3D world.

event.title: Super Mario Galaxy Released
event.description: Super Mario Galaxy launches for the Wii. Mario travels through space and explores planets with different gravitational forces.

event.title: Super Mario Odyssey Released
event.description: Super Mario Odyssey launches for the Nintendo Switch. Mario travels to different kingdoms with his companion Cappy.

event.title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder Released
event.description: Super Mario Bros. Wonder launches for the Nintendo Switch, introducing Wonder Flowers that transform the gameplay in surprising ways.
